Je m’intéressais aux cabinets dentaires autour de Montreux et je suis tombé sur KD1. J’ai vu que vous proposez de l’orthodontie et ça doit recevoir pas mal de demandes au quotidien.

Then you can get booked in if your query is answered. This email covers subjects that include: If you need to cancel an existing appointment. If you have double booked an appointment by accident. Prices for common work types we do and details of what the job entails: Services Repairs Disconnecting radiators or gas appliances Smart Heating Controls Cooker and Hob Installations Landlord/Homeowner Safety Certificates Boiler Quotes Multiple Radiator Quotes Boiler Installations How to book an appointment and best ways to book. Not received a confirmation email after booking If you need to cancel an existing appointment. If you need to cancel an existing appointment we understand that your circumstances can change, all we ask you is to let us know as soon as possible so we can cancel it at our end to free up the appointment for someone else to book not having the appointment avaliable limits the amount of jobs we can do on that day, if you email us can you follow up with a whatsapp up or text message as we don't get to see emails sometimes as the important emails get lost in other not so important emails and we then see them too late to be reactive to the cancellation. Thanks for your co-operation in this. Double booked an appointment by accident. Same as above advice. Prices for common work types we do and details of what the job entails. All prices quoted includes VAT Standard Boiler Service £90 this includes: If you are wanting a service with a known fault on boiler this may be able to be sorted on the service but doesn't cover the repair as extra time maybe needed to do it, if it can be done in the time frame of the service then it would be covered. 1. Clean Condensate trap if required 2. Clean system filter if installed and where practical 3. Check expansion vessel and recharge with air if required 4. Inspect inside boiler for leaks on water gas and flue seals 5. Put boiler into service mode and check manufacturers guidance for correct combustion readings at minimum and maximum gas rates. Also fan pressure test on Worcester boilers when required 6. Check correct gas rate at gas meter or incoming burner pressure at boiler gas valve on maximum. 7. Check flue air integrity to ensure flue and flue seals are correct. 8. Check safety devices 9. Check Flue and Ventilation complies with current gas safety regulations 10. Fill out benchmark service book for boiler warranty if provided by customer and send email gas service record. 11. Check radiators if customer has problems with any and give advice on solutions. Any minor issues ie bleeding radiators included in service price. 12. Advise on any energy efficiency upgrades that would benefit customers if asked and advise on any safety related issues If you require a Major Boiler Service these vary on Boiler Make and Model and can be given on request. Major Boiler services consist of everything listed in the standard boiler service and fully stripping down boiler, jet washing the heat exchanger out and replacing the seals and other various service items recommended by the manufacturer. Secondary appliance services have a £10 discount added when done at same time as first appliance. Gas Fire Service £90 or £80 with boiler service -Check flue with smoke pellet - Inspect chimney - Inspect and clean fire of dust soot and debris - Check condition of fire - Check safety devices on fire - Start fire and check with spillage matches - Gas rate or burner working pressure of fire test. Unvented Cylinder Service £75 or £65 with boiler service - Checking safety devices on cylinder. TPRV PRV Tundishes - Expansion Vessel or Internal Baffle Plate and correcting when necessary. - Inspection of leaks. - Filling out of service booklets for warranty if provided on visit. Repairs to Gas Apliances, Central Heating Systems and Unvented Hot Water Systems. First hour is £90, if we repair the problem in this time with no parts used then that's all you will pay, if we need to use a part from our van stock we will advise on the cost of part, if we don't fix on the first visit we will still charge you for the time diagnosing the problem and give you a quote to fully complete the work once the quote is accepted we will order parts and arrange another visit with you. If you don't accept the quote you will only pay the initial £90 for the fist visit. We charge this as we have to allocate enough time to complete the repair on the first visit which we normally do, only the odd occasion we have to revisit with parts. If we only spent up to 30 mins on the first visit we carry over the extra 30 minutes to the next job so if the part required is going to take 1 hour to replace you only be quoted for half an hour of extra labour. Extra hours of labour is charged at £80 and £40 for half hour. Hopefully this covers most of the repair enquiries but if it doesn't please feel free to ask us but let us know by WhatsApp or text that you have sent an enquiry that isn't covered in the automated reply with your email address so we can find your email more easily. Disconnecting radiators or gas appliances Disconnecting radiators or Gas fire, Gas cooker/oven/hob is £80 all materials are covered in the price. Radiators this includes draining system pressure from radiator and capping valves then repressurising system and testing. Gas appliances requires a gas tightness test before commencing work, then capping appliance with approved method and materials, then re-testing gas supply to ensure no gas leaks are left. Smart Heating Controls We fit all types of heating controls but the most common ones we fit are Hive, Drayton Wiser, Tado and Nest. We can supply and fit or fit Customers Own Supplied Smart Thermostat. Prices for our supplied controls are currently. Hive Heating £260 Hive Mini Heating £220 Drayton Wiser £210 Fit Customers Own single channel (one receiver)£100 If you require a more bespoke system that has extra zones on different floors we can do these but priced on a job to job basis. Cooker or Hob Installations. We charge a set price of £140. Contrary to popular belief replacing a cooker or hob is not a 5 minute one in one out job. This includes any materials required to fit the appliance as long as existing gas supply is within 1 metre of location of new appliance. Materials include copper pipe, copper fittings, new cooker hose, stability chain if required ( freestanding cookers) and gas isolation valve ( gas hobs) to comply with current regulations. Testing of whole house gas installation for gas leaks before we start work and after we finish the work and because we turn gas off we are then liable for the other gas appliances in your property we have a duty of care to go round and relight and visually inspect all gas appliances. Then issuing a job completion report. Landlord/Homeowner Safety Certificates Similar to the standard boiler service described above plus an extra £10 for the certificate if you have a gas cooker or gas hob we charge no extra for the safety check on this. Gas fire safety checks are charged at £50 this is different to the standard gas fire service we do. If you prefer to have the gas fire fully serviced it's charged at £80. Gas fire safety checks include: Checking catchment space for debris. Smoke testing flue to test integrity of entire flue length including bedroom above and loft space, checking chimney outside on rooftop. Lighting and checking flame picture is safe, checking safety valves gas rate or burner working pressure. And finally spillage testing fire in operation. Some examples of combination of appliances and charges. Boiler and Certificate £100 Boiler, Gas Cooker/Hob and Certificate £100 Boiler Gas, Gas Fire, Gas Hob and Certificate £150 Boiler Gas, Gas Fire x2, Gas Hob and Certificate £200 As part of the gas safety check we have to check if you have Carbon Monoxide Alarms fitted in rooms containing gas burning appliances except for cookers/hobs in kitchens. These alarms have to be in date of expiry and in working order. We charge £40 to supply and fit these on request whilst on site and get added to final invoice price. Hopefully this covers most of the Landlord Gas Safety Certificate enquiries but if it doesn't please feel free to ask us but let us know by WhatsApp or text that you have sent an enquiry that isn't covered in the automated reply with your email address so we can find your email more easily. Boiler Quotes We only offer free quotes for boiler replacements and full central heating systems for any repairs we have to diagnose the faults which most of the time can be fixed in the first visit. Boiler Quote booking is only for boiler quotes no tools are used on boiler quotes, if we need to use any tools this is classed as a boiler repair. Multiple Radiator Quotes We only do bespoke quotes for multiple radiators not for single radiators we can give estimates via WhatsApp or text for replacing single radiators in same location or close by but we would require the sizes of radiators to be supplied. Boiler Installations Boiler Installations can't be booked in via the website we manually agree a date with customer after a signed quotation has been received and then we book it into our diary. How to book an appointment and best ways to book. The quickest and easiest way to book is online and below is a step by step guide on how to book online. Top of website click on click here to book online This has 2 drop down menu's leave the third one set to Earliest available appointments, prices for the most common types of work will be in the menu's of Appliance Type. Next page you're presented with a calendar with dates and times available once you pick a date and time you're happy with you go to next page. After selecting date and time the next page is were you input your customer details. You can add additional information if required at the bottom of the address page. Boiler fault codes, alternative number to ring for access etc... Then the final screen is to confirm the booking Confirmations sometimes end up in junk mail so please search there before rebooking another appointment. As we get double booked appointments from time to time and have to contact customer to cancel one of them or customer has to contact us to cancel it. It stops other customers being able to use that timeslot until it's manually cancelled and freed up. If you are having difficulty in booking online feel free to get in touch with us but be aware if you wait for us to get back to you the appointment may get booked by somebody else in the meantime. Hopefully this covers everything anything else please contact us. Regards Smartech Gas Ltd ", "from_email": "info@smartechgas.co.uk", "stats_id": "62e64cfd-7b4a-465e-867f-2e2f970eb07c", "cc": ""}]

draft.body_html:
Ciao Gennaro,

grazie per la risposta così articolata, e nessun problema per i tempi — spero Washington sia stata produttiva.

Mi hai dato un quadro molto chiaro. Non hai bisogno di agganciare clienti (anzi, overflow), ma di allargare la rete di partner paese per paese. In pratica, far conoscere il paradigma Harmonic Innovation a realtà giuste, in posti giusti.

Il motore che usiamo di solito per acquisizione clienti si adatta perfettamente a questo: trova potenziali partner, fa ricerca su ogni organizzazione, e scrive messaggi personalizzati per aprire conversazioni. L’ho già visto funzionare per costruire pipeline di partnership, non solo commerciali.

Se ti va ne parliamo 20 minuti: posso farti vedere come individueremmo i partner giusti in Croazia (e non solo) e quali risultati potresti aspettarti. Nessuna presentazione, solo per capire se ha senso prima di decidere qualsiasi cosa.

Buon rientro,
Andrew
draft.body_translation:
Hi Gennaro,

thanks for such a detailed reply, and no worries about the timing — hope Washington was productive.

You gave me a very clear picture. You don’t need to land clients (you’re dealing with overflow, actually), but you do need to expand your partner network country by country. In practice, getting the Harmonic Innovation paradigm in front of the right people, in the right places.

The engine we normally use for client acquisition adapts perfectly to this: it finds potential partners, researches every organization, and writes personalized messages to start conversations. I’ve already seen it work for building partnership pipelines, not just commercial ones.

If you’re up for it, let’s talk 20 minutes: I can show you how we’d identify the right partners in Croatia (and beyond) and what kind of results you could expect. No presentation, just a chance to see if it makes sense before deciding anything.

Welcome back,
Andrew
draft.triage_summary:
- Original pitch: AI-automated outbound for client acquisition
- Website diagnosis: Entopan is an innovation ecosystem, not a buyer of lead-gen; they partner with startups, corporates, governments; they explicitly said they have an overflow of prospects, no need for client-acquisition help; actual need: expanding partner network internationally
- Diagnosed solution: AI outbound engine repurposed for partner outreach—finding and contacting innovation partners in target countries (including Croatia)
- Fit decision: Pivot explicitly. Gennaro’s reply makes clear he doesn’t need what we originally pitched. The same engine, aimed at partner identification and hyper-personalized outreach, matches the need he described. Pivot to partner acquisition.
- VSL sent? No—none of the existing VSLs fit his vertical or use case
- Objection handled: The “no need for prospecting” objection is sidestepped by repurposing the engine for partner development rather than clients; his stated desire to connect with Croatian companies reinforces the pivot
